title: Otapia
requirements: Design and transition of a complex mechanical character mascot, 'The Engine', from flat concept art into a full 3D asset with moving mouth-wheels and fire-nozzles. Production expanded to create the cinematic product teaser, choreographing character entries, jumps, interactive emblem collisions, and reactive fire VFX. A mid-production brand realignment required rebuilding all identity maps swiftly.
achievements: Resolved 2D-to-3D projection inconsistencies in mechanical nut and sprocket dimensions
Simulated highly realistic fire and particulate smoke using engine-native physics nodes
Successfully adapted active animation pipelines to accommodate mid-production updates
